checks: Independent installed MSVR filename parsing uses the same actual identity/camera/scene fields and fixed dev IDs, verifies both paired sensor files, and reconstructs GT and query indices before requiring raw metadata equality.

Independent np.lexsort(distance, original gallery index) order agrees with inherited stable distance sorting, then applies same-identity/same-scene exclusion. Six metrics, CMC1..50, all groups, every per-query field and query/gallery counts are reconstructed and compared.

Contribution query indices are explicitly interpreted as original dev/gallery rows, so the ordinal-versus-absolute convention noted in the NN review is handled correctly. Positive/negative indices are checked against installed GT.
Contribution delta/interaction equations use the correct R11,R10,R01,R00 signs. Target mean/std comparisons and harmonic/rescue/AP-change directions are consistent.
All 12 source-disjoint base-private conditions require raw cosine distance exactly 2. Full/private/shared state artifacts are all evaluated for every reported frozen condition.
Audit has no Torch/neural import, optimizer, job start, SSH, weight save or original-result mutation. It writes one exclusive independent_cpu_audit.json.
non_blocking: Serialized contribution arithmetic is checked using Python float differences within 1e-7, and target mean/std use NumPy default float64 reconstruction within 1e-7. This is a tolerance-based consistency check, not bitwise float32 recomputation. No actual failing value is established in this source-only review.

The auditor validates contribution reference GT and stored-score arithmetic; it does not independently recompute margin dot products or hardest-reference selection from feature vectors, which are not stored in the raw distance archive. Its report should retain that bounded interpretation.
execution: AST parse only; NumPy/Torch not imported, no audit or model execution, no SSH/GPU actions
